Enumerate every stash with `git stash list --format='%gd %ai %an <%ae> %gs'` and correlate each timestamp against the pool worktree it came from and against known session times, to date the last agent-authored write. Relocate the preserved config snapshot from /tmp into ~/.benchbox with restrictive permissions, keeping the original filename inside the record. description: Two forensic loose ends remain after the identity investigation, and both bear on whether the recurrence is closed or merely quiet. First, the stash count moved: the original catalogue listed FIVE Claude-authored stashes spanning 2026-07-21 to 2026-07-27 across four pool worktrees; a later local inspection listed EIGHT (stash@{1} through stash@{8}). Either the writer was active after 07-27, or some entries were produced during remediation work itself. Those two readings imply opposite conclusions about whether the mechanism is still live, and the question is answerable from stash timestamps and the reflog. Second, the preserved evidence copy was written to /tmp/benchbox-primary-git-config-before-identity.txt; on macOS /tmp is cleared on reboot, which is unsound for an investigation already spanning weeks. AGENTS.md already designates ~/.benchbox for local capture under [REVIEW-CAPTURE-001]. A third ambiguity should be resolved while here: the recorded 'before the previous remediation' snapshot shows .git/config resolving to Joe Harris, i.e. a repo-local [user] block holding the HUMAN value, not the agent value. That is not the contaminated state, so it is unclear whether the contaminated config was ever captured live or whether the block had already flipped back. Record which it was, because it determines what any future verification is comparing against.

anti_patterns.why: The whole value of this item is distinguishing 'writer still live' from 'artifacts of our own remediation', and only the timestamps separate them

anti_patterns.instead: Leave history alone; the merge-time guard keeps agent-authored commits off develop
anti_patterns.why: A prior identity-history rewrite in this repository corrupted 2286 commits on main and 1850 on published-results, undetected for roughly 2.5 months

anti_patterns.why: [REVIEW-CAPTURE-001] confines in-review capture to local ~/.benchbox drafts; hosted sync needs its own approval

work_units.evidence: CONTAMINATED CONFIG WAS NEVER CAPTURED LIVE. The preserved "before" snapshot (2026-08-03 19:41) contains a [user] block reading Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com> - the HUMAN value. What it does prove is the mechanism: the primary clone carried a repo-local [user] block at all, which every linked worktree inherits. That block is gone today (no [user] section in the primary .git/config), consistent with the recorded remediation. WRITER IS NOT LIVE, and the extra stashes are NOT new events: the count moved 5->8 but all eight fall inside the already-catalogued 07-21..07-27 window, so they were undercounted rather than added. Last observed config write 2026-07-24 13:02; newest agent stash 2026-07-27 10:30; nothing agent-authored since. The INSTRUCTION however is still live - re-issued 2026-08-03 21:48 - but was not executed that time. Rungs: 1 PASS (durable record outside /tmp), 2 PASS (22 stashes >= 8, none dropped), 3 PASS (primary clone working tree and index clean).
